hero.title: Scalable trust
hero.p1: True Aim is a Swiss company, spun out of Yarowa, Switzerland's leading insurtech, and supported by Innosuisse, the innovation arm of the Swiss government, on the strength of the technology we have built.
hero.p2: We are building towards an industry where the answer arrives at the speed of the evidence, where every decision records the facts, the rules and the reasoning behind it and where that record holds up under audit, regulatory review or dispute.
hero.p4: It asks for precision beyond what the market demands today, honesty about which decisions a machine should compute and which require human judgment and the discipline to solve the problems the industry is actually facing.
hero.p5: This is the work we have chosen.
hero.imageAlt: The True Aim symbol in glass and metal

mission.label: Mission
mission.text: To bring scalable trust to claims decisions. Every decision fast enough to matter, accurate enough to rely on and proven whenever it is questioned.
mission.attribution: Reuben John, CEO of True Aim

reuben.name: Reuben John
reuben.title: Co-founder and CEO
reuben.bio: Lawyer and operator. Reuben has led operational and regulatory projects across Europe and Africa, from market expansion to compliance programmes for multinational clients. He runs the company, its strategy and its commercial work.

frederic.name: Frederic Brunner
frederic.title: Co-founder and CTO
frederic.bio: More than 30 years in software and 20 in enterprise automation, including at Zurich Insurance. Frederic leads the technology and the engineering work.

alin.name: Alin Koppandi
alin.title: Senior AI Engineer
alin.bio: Builds the True Aim platform, from document reading to the decision engine and the record behind each decision.

kai.name: Kai Praschma
kai.title: AI Solutions Specialist
kai.bio: Builds the automation that runs True Aim's operations and client delivery, and turns research into the tools, content and systems the team works with every day.

henrique.name: Henrique Ferreira
henrique.title: Implementation Specialist
henrique.bio: Guides claims teams from first conversation to a running platform, shaping each deployment around their own claims, invoices and damage reports.

arnaud.name: Arnaud Terville
arnaud.title: Commercial Lead
arnaud.bio: Brings enterprise insurance technology experience from Solera, Quantexa and Apple, where he helped multinational organisations adopt new platforms at scale. At True Aim he leads the commercial relationships that bring the platform into claims operations.
